evals.name: linkedin-general-audience
evals.prompt: Humanize this LinkedIn post. Internally we say ship, sprint and deploy, but the people reading it are a general audience.
evals.expected_output: Signature line, the final post without AI patterns, and a change table. Team jargon adjusted for a general audience, no invented figures (the 'dropped significantly' claim gets a placeholder or a question), no em-dash asides, no 'not just a tool' frame, no stock opening or comment-bait closing.

evals.name: blog-no-fabrication
evals.prompt: Can you make this blog post sound less like ChatGPT? It's for my own travel blog.
evals.expected_output: No memories, place names, durations or figures added that are not in the source; where concrete detail is needed there is a placeholder or a question to the writer. Brochure voice removed. The US/UK spelling mix (traveler, cozy vs colours) is pointed out and made consistent.

evals.name: academic-light-touch
evals.prompt: Could you lightly edit my abstract? It's going to a journal, so please don't change too much.
evals.expected_output: Light touch: academic register, passive in the methods and hedged claims kept; the sample size, the statistics and the cut-off time unchanged; 'is associated with' not turned into a causal claim; only the inflation (pivotal role, delves, multifaceted, underscore, paving the way) and the filler removed. UK spelling (analysed) kept.

evals.name: story-dialogue
evals.prompt: Make this scene from my short story sound more natural. It reads like AI wrote it.
evals.expected_output: Dialogue and quotation marks kept; the named emotions and stock images (wave of nostalgia, breath she didn't know she'd been holding, mixture of grief and determination, a dog barked) replaced with what is in the scene; fancy tags plain; any added physical detail listed as 'added detail'. The plot and the ending unchanged.

evals.name: diagnose-human-text
evals.prompt: My friend says she wrote this herself, but it feels like AI to me. What do you think? Don't touch the text, just assess it.
evals.expected_output: The text is not rewritten. The verdict says the AI evidence is weak and names the human marks (specific odd details, mixed feelings, regional words, the self-interruption). The single dash aside is not treated as proof.

evals.name: developer-jargon
evals.prompt: Humanize this section of our team wiki. The readers are developers.
evals.expected_output: Developer terms kept (PR, CI/CD, branch, merge, staging) and not spelled out; buzzwords (robust, seamless, state-of-the-art, empowering) and inflated wording (utilizing, prior to, commenced) gone; heading case made consistent; no emoji or 'Happy coding'. Code, branch names and the Tuesday/Thursday schedule unchanged.

evals.name: bank-email-facts
evals.prompt: Rewrite this customer e-mail so it sounds like a person wrote it.
evals.expected_output: The rate change (3.10% AER to 2.85% AER), the date (1 December 2026) and the 30-day switching right appear exactly as written, near the top. The e-mail formulas (hope this email finds you well, reaching out, don't hesitate) and the stock opening are gone. Greeting and sign-off kept; no reason for the change invented.

evals.name: health-leaflet-safety
evals.prompt: This patient leaflet sounds robotic. Can you humanize it?
evals.expected_output: Drug name, dose (one 500 mg tablet twice a day with meals), the two-week dose review, the side effects, the warning signs and the instruction to stop and contact a doctor all unchanged. Hedges reduced to one per claim but not removed (may stays may). Therapist voice and the slogan ending removed.
